t: Hundred Years' War: John, Duke of Normandy, laid siege to the town of Aiguillon.
Hundred Years' War: At the Battle of Crécy, English forces established the military supremacy of English longbows over the French combination of crossbows and armoured knights.
Hundred Years' War: Under the terms of Scotland's Auld Alliance with France, King David II of Scotland was captured at the Battle of Neville's Cross following his invasion of England.
